description.en: Skills manager for DeepSeek Harness settings: import Agent Skills from Git repositories, group them by repository, enable or disable each skill, and preview SKILL.md content. Disabled skills are not registered with the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Skills 管理器：在设置里从 Git 仓库导入 Agent Skills，按仓库分组管理，逐项启用或停用，并可展开查看 SKILL.md 正文；停用的技能不会注册进模型。
